{{Update |title1 = v1.55.0 |image1 = BruteThumbnail.png |release_date = 26 February 2025 (v1.55.0) |minor_updates = v1.55.0a (26 February 2025) |feed_title = Easy Mini-Rework 🧪 |feed_color = Red |previous_update = [[v1.54.0]] |next_update = [[v1.56.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.55.0''' is the one hundred and eight update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 26th of February 2025. It introduced the [[Brute]] as [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode's boss and added new [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode soundtracks. This version contains two updates, the main v1.55.0 update (released 26 February 2025) and the minor v1.55.0a update (released 26 February 2025). ==Additions== *[[Brute]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Grave Digger]] changed. **Health increased from 17,500 to 60,000. **Cash given increased from {{Money|2,500}} to {{Money|20,000}} every 10% health. **''Stomp'' ability changed. ***Stun time increased from 3 to 5 seconds. ***Cooldown increased from 20 to 60. **''Shovel'' ability changed. ***Stun time decreased from 6 to 3 seconds. ***Cooldown increased from 10 to 45. **''Summon'' ability changed. ***Summon time is now always 6 seconds instead of varying between 5 and 8 seconds. ***Now can spawn the [[Hazmat]] with a 20% chance and a 0.15 second delay. ***Now can spawn the [[Enraged]] with a 30% chance and a 0.1 second delay. ***[[Normal Boss]] chance increased from 6.67% to 50%, and its delay has been decreased from 0.5 to 0.25 seconds. ***No longer summons the [[Armored]], used to have a 13.33% chance and a 0.5 second delay. ***No longer summons the [[Breaker2]], used to have a 53.33% chance and a 0.1 second delay. ***No longer summons the [[Bolt]], used to have a 26.67% chance and a 0.25 second delay. *[[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode changed. **Wave structure changed. **Starting cash is now always {{Money|500}} ({{Money|600}} with the group bonus), regardless of player count. **Final wave music changed to ''They Are Coming...''. **Updated icon. *[[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode changed. **Wave structure changed. **Icon changed. *[[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode music changed. **Early-game tracks now include ''Biohazard'' and ''Synthesia'' instead of ''Into The Void'', ''Melancholy Hill'', ''Rebelution'', ''Rain Dance'' and ''The Horde''. **Mid-game tracks now include ''Liminal Oblivion'', ''Oasis Plague'' and ''Drezzed'' instead of ''Contaiment Breach'', ''Shellshock'', ''Neuro Raze'', ''Art Of War'' and ''Fill Them With Lead''. **Late-game tracks now include ''Sound The Alarm!'', ''Funky Zombie'' and ''Contaiment Breach'' instead of ''Catharsis'', ''Desolate Dystopia'' and ''Portal To Hell''. *Valentine [[Mission Quests]] are no longer available. *Removed "''revamped''" from [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode, replaced "''new''" with "''revamped''" for [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode and added "''revamped''" to [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. *Fixed {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} [[Warden]] having a black hat at Level 4. *Fixed [[Dummy Boss]] using the placeholder icon. :In '''v1.55.0a''': *Fixed [[Grave Digger]] getting stuck after using its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} BruteThumbnail.png V1.49.0Thumbnail.png FirstPersonMinigunnerThumbnail.png RocketeerThumbnail.png
